objects.name: totals
variables: It shows one row for each region with a numeric total.
It sums only the rows whose status is paid.
It sums the order amount, and it groups by region.
The object `rows` shows fewer than 600 rows.
notes: Object `totals` has the live paid total of amount for each region. When `rows` shows 600, read `totals` as the final answer. A column can get a new name: a runner must repair `totals` by use of the new names.
